drhp.business: Omnitech manufactures highly engineered precision machined components and assemblies (weight 0.003 kg to 503.33 kg, precision up to 5 microns) majorly used in safety-critical applications. With 19 years of experience it supplied over 256 customers across 24 countries during FY23-H1FY26, deriving the majority of revenue from exports (~75%). Products serve Energy (oil & gas, wind, power), Motion Control & Automation, Industrial Equipment Systems and other diversified industrial applications.
